data.notes_barbara:
Different products; Different customers; Different business model

Simply Good Foods sells packaged nutrition snacks and shakes. It does not operate restaurants or provide franchise services.
data.notes_matthew: Simply Good Foods is Quest and Atkins bars sold through retailers. Same story as the other packaged food companies.

data.reason: Wendy's operates and franchises quick-service hamburger restaurants, selling prepared food to consumers at drive-thrus, in restaurants and by delivery. Simply Good Foods owns packaged protein and low-carb snack brands, such as Quest, and sells them through grocery, club and mass retailers and online. The products differ: prepared restaurant meals against shelf-stable packaged snacks. The routes to market differ: restaurants and franchisees against retail distribution. The business models differ: franchise royalties and restaurant sales against branded product sales made by contract manufacturers. The only link is that both sell food to consumers.
Different business model: Simply Good Foods distributes nutritional snacks and meals through retail and e-commerce channels; Wendy's serves prepared restaurant meals.

P2.1.text: About Us | The Simply Good Foods Company

P2.2.text: At Simply Good Foods, our mission is to empower and educate consumers about how to eat right and snack smarter through our education, advocacy, products and tools. Our vision is to lead the nutritional snacking movement with trusted brands that offer a rich variety of innovative, convenient, better-for-you snacks and meals that provide optimal nutrition for everyone.

P2.3.text: With our heritage of science-based nutrition, we are committed to growing our portfolio of nutritious snacking brands. We distribute our products in major retail channels including grocery, club and mass merchandise, as well as through e-commerce, convenience, specialty and other channels. Our strong platform allows us to introduce new products, expand distribution, and appeal to current and potential consumers. We are well-positioned to continue to selectively pursue acquisition opportunities in the nutritious snacking and broader health and wellness food space.
